fullDescription:
A full day around the Phi Phi group with the boat left up to you.

The choice between a speedboat and a catamaran is the one decision worth making before you book. A speedboat gets there fast and gives you longer at each stop. A catamaran is slower and far steadier, with a deck to sit on properly, and it is the better call if anyone in the group feels the sea. Both cover the same route.

Pileh Lagoon is the stop people book for. It is a deep channel of green water enclosed by cliffs on every side, so still that the surface holds the reflection of the walls around it, and swimming in it is the closest thing Thailand has to swimming inside a mountain.

Maya Bay is on Phi Phi Leh. It reopened in 2022 after four years closed for the reef to recover, and it runs on the current rules: boats moor at the back of the island and visitors walk in through it, which is a better arrival than pulling up on the beach ever was.

The snorkelling on this route is the kind where fish come to you. The reefs around Phi Phi are used to people, so the shoals hold their ground instead of scattering, and you see more in twenty minutes than an hour somewhere wilder.

Buffet lunch and free time on Phi Phi Don, the inhabited island, fill the middle of the day.

We book with the operator directly, so your place is held with them before your booking is final. The price covers hotel pickup and drop-off in Ao Nang and Krabi Town, the boat transfer with certified crew, an English-speaking guide and the buffet lunch.

Eight hours. National park fees are collected at the pier unless confirmed otherwise, so carry cash. Minimum one day's notice.
highlights: Pick a fast speedboat or a steadier catamaran
Swim in Pileh Lagoon, walled by cliffs on every side
Maya Bay on its current post-2022 arrival route
Reef fish here hold their ground instead of scattering
Buffet lunch and free time on Phi Phi Don

fullDescription:
The four islands run as a snorkelling trip, with the clownfish colonies as the thing you are actually going for.

Clownfish live inside sea anemones in a partnership that works both ways: the anemone's stinging tentacles keep predators off the fish, and the fish drive off the polyp-eaters that would otherwise graze the anemone down. The fish are coated in a mucus layer that stops the anemone firing on them. They are also fiercely territorial for their size, and a resident male will square up to a mask that gets too close, which is a thing worth having happen to you at least once.

The colonies here sit in shallow water close to the beaches, which is what makes this a good snorkel for people who are not strong swimmers. In several spots you can stand.

The rest of the route is the standard circuit: Poda, Chicken Island, Tup and Mor, with the Thale Waek sandbar walkable when the tide drops far enough to link them.

The guide is local and picks the snorkelling stops on the day, because which reef is worth your time depends on the tide and how much wind has been through.

Six hours is a comfortable length: long enough to swim properly at every stop, short enough to leave you an evening.

We book with the operator directly, so your place is held with them before your booking is final. The price covers hotel pickup and drop-off in selected areas, the boat trip to the four islands, snorkelling equipment, a life jacket and a professional local guide.

National park fees are collected at the pier unless confirmed otherwise. Minimum one day's notice.
highlights: Clownfish colonies in shallow water close to the beach
Shallow enough to stand in at several stops
Poda, Chicken Island, Tup and Mor on the same run
Snorkel stops chosen on the day by a local guide
Six hours, so an evening left afterwards

fullDescription:
Half an hour feeding elephants in traditional Thai dress, which turns the visit into the photographs you actually keep.

The costume is provided and is the reason most people pick this version over the plain feeding programme. Standing beside an elephant in Thai dress produces a set of pictures that look nothing like a phone snap in shorts, and the sanctuary is set up for it: the light, the background and the animals are all used to the routine.

You feed the herd by hand. Elephant food here is bananas and sugarcane, and an adult Asian elephant works through something like 150 kilograms of plant matter a day, which reorders your sense of what keeping one involves.

No riding, no chains during the programme, no performances. The elephants came out of logging and riding work and live on land the sanctuary keeps for them.

Thirty minutes on dry ground is the right length for this. You stay clean, the costume stays clean, and it fits either side of a boat trip without taking the day.

One practical note: bring your own makeup if you want it, because the costume is provided and the styling is not.

Hotel transfer from Ao Nang, Klong Muang and Nopparat Thara is included, along with the elephant food and the costume.

We book with the operator directly, so your place is held with them before your booking is final.

Minimum one day's notice.
highlights: Traditional Thai costume provided for the photographs
Feed the herd by hand: bananas and sugarcane
No riding, no chains, no performances
Dry ground, so you and the costume stay clean
Bring your own makeup; the styling is not included

fullDescription:
The four islands on a longtail, run at a pace that lets each stop be a stop rather than a photograph.

The longtail is the right boat for this route and not a compromise. Its shallow draught and long-shaft propeller get into water that speedboats have to anchor well clear of, so you are put down closer to the beach and closer to the reef. At its speed the coastline between the islands is part of the day instead of something you bounce across at thirty knots.

The circuit is Poda, Chicken Island, Tup and Mor. Thale Waek, the Separated Sea, is the sandbar that surfaces as the tide drops and joins the islands into a strip you can walk. It is the photograph everyone comes home with, and whether it is there depends on the tide on the day, so the schedule follows the tide table.

Chicken Island has the snorkelling: shallow coral just off the sand, close enough that you do not need to be a confident swimmer.

Thai lunch is served during the trip, with seasonal fruit and drinking water through the day.

Six hours with hotel pickup and drop-off at both ends is the standard Krabi island day done properly: long enough to swim at every stop, short enough to leave the evening free.

We book with the operator directly, so your place is held with them before your booking is final. The price covers hotel pickup and drop-off, a professional guide, the longtail boat tour, Thai lunch, seasonal fruit and drinking water.

National park fees are collected at the pier unless confirmed otherwise, so carry cash. Minimum one day's notice.
highlights: Longtail reaches shallows speedboats anchor away from
Walk the Thale Waek sandbar when the tide drops
Shallow snorkelling off Chicken Island
Thai lunch, fruit and water through the day
Six hours, with the evening left free

fullDescription:
Phang Nga Bay on a speedboat capped at twenty people, with the national park fees already in the price.

The cap is the product. Standard Phang Nga boats run forty or more, and the bottleneck on this route is never the sailing, it is the moving: queueing to get off at each stop, queueing to get back on, snorkelling in a crowd. Twenty clears every stop in half the time, and the saved time goes into the water.

The bay is the reason to come. Limestone towers rise straight out of flat green water, and the islands are riddled with sea caves and hongs, collapsed cave systems that open into hidden lagoons reachable only through low tunnels at the right tide.

National park fees are included rather than collected at the pier. That means the price you see here is what the day costs, with nothing collected at the pier.

Transfers run from Khao Lak and Phuket, which makes this the version to book if you are based on that coast rather than in Ao Nang.

Eight hours on a speedboat across open bay water is a full day. Anyone who feels the sea should take something before boarding rather than after.

We book with the operator directly, so your place is held with them before your booking is final. The price covers hotel transfer from Khao Lak or Phuket, the VIP speedboat capped at twenty, national park fees, snorkelling equipment, life jackets and a local guide.

Minimum one day's notice.
highlights: Speedboat capped at twenty, so no queueing at stops
Limestone towers and hidden hong lagoons
National park fees included, not charged at the pier
Transfers from Khao Lak and Phuket
Eight hours across the bay with a local guide

fullDescription:
Half an hour on a supervised range in Ao Nang, with instruction in English throughout.

Thailand licenses commercial ranges tightly, and the practical effect is that everything is run by an instructor standing beside you: loading, stance, grip and the firing line itself. Nothing is handled unsupervised at any point, and you do not need any prior experience.

What you shoot depends on the package you book, so check which firearms and how many rounds are in the option you select before you pay. The range publishes different packages and they are not interchangeable.

Thirty minutes is the right length. Range time is concentrated rather than long, and a first session is about learning to hold a stance and place a group on paper rather than getting through as much ammunition as possible.

Instructors give the briefing and the running corrections in basic English, which is what matters here: you want to understand the safety instruction exactly, not approximately.

Ear and eye protection are standard on the line. Wear closed shoes and a shirt with a high neckline, because spent brass is hot when it lands.

We book with the operator directly, so your place is held with them before your booking is final. The price covers the firearms and ammunition for your chosen package and instruction in basic English.

Minimum one day's notice, and bring photo identification.
highlights: Supervised throughout by an instructor on the line
No previous experience needed
Firearms and rounds depend on the package you book
Briefing and corrections given in basic English
Closed shoes and a high neckline: spent brass lands hot
